plain: Of the same age or time period.

webster.text: Of the same age; beginning to exist at the same time; of equal age; usually and properly followed by with.

example.quote: The evil is coeval with her existence — there are always opposite parties in that republic.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 12, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
